name: c00lgui (c00lkidd Panel) [c00lgui Remastered!]
desc:
Welcome to c00lgui!

Dive into a simulation inspired by the legendary GUI of c00lkidd 🔥
Powerful commands, chaotic effects, and hidden references await you.
Anything can happen here: unpredictable scripts, a glitchy atmosphere, and total chaos!

🗨️ A secure and available chat system:
A message in the chat will tell you who you can talk to so you never get lost.
A Safe Chat is integrated so everyone can talk together, even players of different age groups.

⚠️ Note:
This game is made purely for fun and nostalgia.
It has no intention to harm, no real hacks, just a GUI inspired by the legend.
❗ The game cannot ban your account, you can play safely.

🎮 What to do in the game?
• Explore the universe
• Test commands and scripts
• Unleash chaos
• Discover hidden surprises
• Find all the game badges and show
that you are a true fan of c00lkidd! 🏆

📜 CREDITS

👑 Creator: @MagicienFurious
🛠️ Scripts / GUI: @MagicienFurious, @Florianne10
🧠 Inspiration: c00lkidd, Forsaken
